mostWorthwhile.text: Building the gravity and acceleration organs was most worthwhile: the weighted-gel comparison distinguishes a head starting to move from steady motion and explains how hair bundles bend.

leastWorthwhile.text: Grouping the two organs beside the cochlea was straightforward but added little functional explanation.

surprise.text: The final view clarified how eye movements oppose a head turn to steady a fixed point, while balance signals also contribute to posture.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless, although combining the already-built organs before adding nerves felt more like an assembly step than a meaningful physiological change.

continue.text: I would continue: the sensory comparisons and final reflex connection made the structures useful, though the intermediate assembly was predictable.
